name: PSYCHIC
text: A tag with no effect of its own. Other teams' rules may read it; it does not satisfy Astartes for Legionaries.

name: Siphon Life
text: The Balefire Acolyte may name a friendly Legionary it can see within 6 inches before dice resolve; every attack die it resolves that hurts the target heals the named friend by 1 wound, or D3 for a crit. Once per turning point across both weapons.

name: ASTARTES
text: A Legionary may double up in one activation: two Shoots or two Fights. A double Shoot must use a bolt pistol, boltgun or tainted bolt pistol at least once (the same weapon twice is fine). Its order never stops it counteracting.

name: KHORNE: Wrathful Onslaught
text: Melee weapons of a KHORNE operative have Severe.

name: NURGLE: Disgusting Vigour
text: Each attack die of Normal Dmg 3 or more that hurts a NURGLE operative gets a D6; on a 5+ it does 1 less. Crits, Devastating and other damage are never reduced.

name: SLAANESH: Unnatural Agility
text: A SLAANESH operative has +1 inch of Move (injury still takes 2 inches; the floor is 4 inches).

name: TZEENTCH: Empyreal Guidance
text: Ranged weapons of a TZEENTCH operative have Severe.

name: UNDIVIDED: Vicious Reavers
text: An UNDIVIDED operative has Ceaseless on its weapons when shooting, fighting or retaliating against an enemy within 6 inches of it, checked per target.

name: In the Eyes of the Gods
text: The first time in each of its own activations that the Aspiring Champion incapacitates an enemy, it has +1 APL until that activation ends.

name: Daemonic Aura
text: When an enemy within the Chosen's control range declares a Fall Back, roll a D6: on a 3+ the Fall Back is cancelled, its AP is refunded and that enemy cannot Fall Back again this activation or counteraction.

name: Soul Gorge
text: Once a fight the Chosen took part in is over, if it is still standing and it killed its opponent or landed a damaging crit strike, it heals up to D3+1 wounds.

name: Unleash Daemon
text: Once per battle, when the Anointed is activated, it unleashes the daemon for the rest of the battle: no Pick Up Marker or mission actions (a carried marker is placed at once), every attack die of Normal or Critical Dmg 4 or more does 1 less to it, and its daemonic claw gains Ceaseless and Lethal 5+.

name: Devastating Onslaught
text: Enemies cannot assist against the Butcher when it fights or retaliates. At the end of each enemy activation or counteraction, the Butcher may take a free Charge of up to 2 inches that ends in the control range of an enemy within 2 inches of it, switching to Engage if needed.

name: Icon Bearer
text: Adds 1 to its APL in the marker-control count only; its real APL is unchanged, so APL changes still apply on top.

name: Favoured of the Dark Gods
text: Each Ready step, an objective the Icon Bearer holds that nobody has tainted yet becomes tainted for good and its player gains 1 CP. No marker can be tainted twice, by either side.

name: Vicious Reflexes
text: When the Shrivetalon retaliates, its side resolves the first attack die of the fight instead of the attacker.

name: Horrifying Dismemberment
text: A kill the Shrivetalon makes in melee (fighting or retaliating) horrifies a second enemy that it or the victim can see within 3 inches: that enemy has 1 less APL until its next activation is over.

name: GRISLY MARK
text: The Shrivetalon sets its Grisly marker down within its control range, where it stays for the battle. Enemies within 3 inches of it pay 1 extra AP for Pick Up Marker and mission actions, and their side counts 1 less APL on any marker they contest from there. Once per battle; not while an enemy is in its control range.

name: Infernal Pact
text: Once per battle for the whole kill team, when a friendly Warrior is activated, you may change its Mark of Chaos to a different one. The new mark applies at once.
